rules.sentence: The Domain layer must not reference the Web layer.
rules.because: Domain is UI-agnostic; transaction boundaries live in services.
rules.fix: Define an abstraction in Domain and implement it in Web.

rules.sentence: Each of the projects matching `MyApp.*` must not reference the others.
rules.because: Each MyApp project is its own deployable unit; a reference from one into another couples their release cadences.
rules.fix: Move the shared type into a project both may reference, or reach the other project through an abstraction it owns.

rules.sentence: Each of the projects matching `MyApp.*` must be referenced only by itself.
rules.because: A project anything may reach into has no surface to change; every edge into it is part of its contract whether or not anyone meant it to be.
rules.fix: Reach the project through an abstraction it owns, or move the type both projects need into a project both may reference.

rules.sentence: Each of the Reporting and Invoicing layers must not have circular references with the others.
rules.because: Reporting and invoicing are two cuts of the web layer with no intended order between them; a circle means neither can be extracted without dragging the other along.
rules.fix: Move what one cut borrows from the other into a type both may reach, or pick a direction and state it as an ordering rule.

rules.sentence: Types in `MyApp.Legacy.Billing.*` must not reference types in `MyApp.Web.*`.
rules.because: Billing must not reach up into the web layer.

rules.sentence: Types in the Web layer named `*Controller` must not reference types in `System.Data.*`.
rules.because: Repository pattern for testability.
rules.fix: Inject the repository.

rules.sentence: The Web layer must not use `DateTime.Now` or `DateTime.UtcNow`.
rules.because: Wall-clock reads are untestable; inject IClock.
rules.fix: Take IClock in the constructor; see OrderService for the pattern.

rules.sentence: Methods of the Web layer returning `Task` or `Task<TResult>` must be named `*Async`.
rules.because: Async methods are discovered by their Async suffix.
rules.fix: Rename the method to end in Async and update its callers.

rules.sentence: Types, except `HandlerRegistry`, must not construct types implementing `IHandler<T>`.
rules.because: Handlers are resolved through HandlerRegistry; direct construction bypasses discovery.
rules.fix: Resolve the handler through HandlerRegistry instead of constructing it.

rules.sentence: Singleton-registered types must not inject scoped-registered types or transient-registered types.
rules.because: A singleton that captures a scoped or transient service pins it to the whole process lifetime.
rules.fix: Inject IServiceScopeFactory and resolve the dependency inside a scope.

rules.sentence: Types in `MyApp.Domain.*` must not reference types in `MyApp.Ghost.*`.
rules.because: Nothing should reference the (nonexistent) ghost layer.

warnings.message: This rule is inert: its target selection matched no types.
warnings.hint: A trailing `.*` covers the namespace itself and everything under it, and `Legacy*` never crosses a dot; a rule whose target matches nothing passes forever, so decide before keeping it.

rules.sentence: Types in `MyApp.Nowhere.*` must be named `*Service`.
rules.because: A subject that matches nothing must fail loudly.

violations.detail: The subject selection matched no solution-declared types.
violations.hint: A trailing `.*` covers the namespace itself and everything under it, and `Legacy*` never crosses a dot; check the selection against what the solution declares.

rules.sentence: Types in `MyApp.Legacy.Billing.*`, except `IBillingFacade` or `BillingFacade`, must be referenced only by types in `MyApp.Legacy.Billing.*`, `IBillingFacade` or `BillingFacade`.
rules.because: Replacement scheduled; not worth stabilizing.
rules.fix: use `IBillingFacade`

rules.sentence: The Web layer must not catch `Exception`.
rules.because: A catch-all hides the failures you meant to handle; catch the specific exception instead.
rules.fix: Catch the specific exception type you can handle, not System.Exception.

rules.sentence: The Domain layer must throw only `OrderRuleViolation`.
rules.because: Domain code signals rule failures with the domain's own exception, not a generic BCL type.
rules.fix: Throw OrderRuleViolation (or another domain exception) instead of a BCL exception type.

rules.sentence: Methods of the Web layer returning `Task` or `Task<TResult>` must accept a parameter of type `CancellationToken`.
rules.because: A Task-returning method that ignores cancellation cannot be stopped once its caller has moved on.
rules.fix: Add a CancellationToken parameter and flow it to the calls you await.

rules.sentence: The Web layer must not expose `DataTable`.
rules.because: An infrastructure type on a presentation-layer public signature couples every caller to it; return a DTO or view model.
rules.fix: Return a DTO instead of exposing System.Data.DataTable.

rules.sentence: The Web or Domain layers must not catch `Exception` without a `when` filter.
rules.because: An unfiltered broad catch swallows every failure alike; a `when` filter names the ones this handler actually expects.
rules.fix: Add a `when` filter naming the exceptions you can handle, or catch those types directly.

rules.sentence: The Web or Domain layers must not swallow `Exception`.
rules.because: A handler that catches everything and continues hands its caller a wrong answer that reads like a right one; rethrowing keeps the failure travelling.
rules.fix: Rethrow after cleanup, translate to a domain exception, or add a `when` filter naming what you can handle.

rules.sentence: The Domain layer must not throw `InvalidOperationException`.
rules.because: InvalidOperationException tells a caller nothing it can dispatch on; the domain has its own exception for rule failures.
rules.fix: Throw OrderRuleViolation instead of System.InvalidOperationException.

rules.sentence: Types named `*Service` must reside in project `MyApp.Web`.
rules.because: Services are wired by the web host; a service outside MyApp.Web escapes its registration sweep.
rules.fix: Move the service into the MyApp.Web project.

rules.sentence: Types named `*Service` must have exactly one counterpart named `I{Name}` among interfaces.
rules.because: A caller that can only name the concrete service cannot be handed a different one; the I{Name} contract is where a double or a second implementation goes.
rules.fix: Extract an I{Name} interface for the service and consume that.

rules.sentence: Types in `MyApp.*` must belong to the Domain layer or the Web layer.
rules.because: A type in no declared layer is governed by no layer rule; the two layers are the covering set.
rules.fix: Move the type into a declared layer's namespace, or declare its layer in this spec.

rules.sentence: Types implementing `IHandler<T>` or types named `*Scheduler` must be registered.
rules.because: Handlers and schedulers are resolved from the container; one that is never registered fails at dispatch, not at startup.
rules.fix: Register the type in ServiceWiring.Configure.

rules.sentence: Properties of the Domain layer must be get-only.
rules.because: A value a caller can reassign after construction is not a value; the invariants the constructor checked stop holding the moment anyone writes to it.
rules.fix: Take the value in the constructor and expose it `{ get; }`; hand back a new instance for a changed one.

rules.sentence: Static fields of the Web layer must be readonly.
rules.because: A writable static is state the whole process shares; the last write anywhere decides what the next request reads, and nothing in the signature says so.
rules.fix: Make the field `readonly` or `const`, or move the state onto an instance whose lifetime the caller controls.

rules.sentence: Projects matching `MyApp.*` must target only `net8.0`.
rules.because: The hosts this app deploys to are on the net8.0 LTS; a project that targets anything newer builds here and fails to start there.
rules.fix: Set `TargetFramework` to `net8.0`, or upgrade the hosts first and move this rule with them.

rules.sentence: Projects matching `MyApp.*` must reference no NuGet packages (declared references only; transitive dependencies are not seen).
rules.because: This solution builds on an agent with no feed access; a `PackageReference` is the one thing in a project file that needs the network.
rules.fix: Use a type the SDK already supplies, or reference an assembly the repository carries.

rules.sentence: Project `MyApp.Web` must lock package restore.
rules.because: An unpinned restore resolves a different package graph on a different day; the build CI passed is then not the build that ships.
rules.fix: Set `RestorePackagesWithLockFile` to true and commit the lock file the next restore produces.

rules.sentence: Projects matching `MyApp.*`, except project `MyApp.Legacy.Billing`, must not be packable.
rules.because: The SDK packs by default, so a project nobody meant to publish is one `dotnet pack` away from a package on a feed.
rules.fix: Set `IsPackable` to false in the project file.
